name: Angel's Tale: An Extraordinary Love Story
source:
This is the story of a young man named "Prach" who has a unique ability to see things that others cannot. He lives together with his sister "Fa" during his parents' work trips. The simple life of "Prach" becomes a disaster when strange creatures, that no one can see, show up and try to harm him.

"Prach" must find a way to survive this weird situation. This leads to the discovery of the secret of "Fa", who is actually more than his sister. Not to mention the visit of "Manari", a mysterious girl who claims to be a demon. And her goal is him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728740/Angels_Tale__An_extraordinary_love_story/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是关于名叫普拉奇的年轻人的故事，他拥有看见他人无法看见之物的独特能力。父母出差时，他与妹妹法一起生活。普拉奇的简单生活在某天变成灾难：奇怪生物出现并试图伤害他，但没有人能看见它们。

普拉奇必须想办法在这场怪事中活下来，并由此发现法的秘密：她其实不只是他的妹妹。更不用说，还有名叫玛娜莉的神秘女孩来访，自称是恶魔，而她的目标正是普拉奇。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728740/Angels_Tale__An_extraordinary_love_story/]Steam[/url]]
